phrase_pron: /teɪk ðə fɔːl/ 美音 /teɪk ðə fɑːl/
trap_x: 字面意思：接受这次摔倒
trap_check: 真正意思：替别人背锅、顶罪

examples.en: Who will take the fall for the scandal?
He'll get one of his associates to take the fall.
examples.cn: 他会找个手下替他顶罪。

examples.en: Matthew Mott was dispensable enough to take the fall
examples.cn: 莫特无足轻重，只能去背锅。
